title: Heather & Mark
purpose: Fix-pass shotlist scoped to the ~35 jobs in fix-jobs.json (7 blockers + 26 systemic lettering re-letters + 2 new wide-establish beats). This is NOT a full 69-panel retroactive shotlist -- per qa-scaffold-PLAN.md section 8 step 3, only the touched panels are entered. Content (characters/location/camera/action/costume_state/tier) was derived from direct visual inspection of projects/heather-and-mark/panels/*, cross-checked against qa-report.md and panel-transcriptions.md.

cast.name: Heather
cast.note: protagonist; undergoes the muscle-growth transformation arc. muscle_size_tier follows the ladder in _tier_map below.

cast.name: Mark
cast.note: supportive partner; does NOT transform in this story. Held at muscle_size_tier 0 in every panel he appears in -- there is no visual or narrative evidence anywhere in the touched panels of Mark gaining size.

_tier_map.note: Coarse per-act muscle_size_tier integer ladder for Heather, mapped from the owner's 6-rung framing (baseline/subtle/14.5in/18in/140lb/200lb) per qa-scaffold-PLAN.md section 8 step 3. Documented here (top-level) AND restated in cast[0].note per the plan's instruction to note it in a top-level comment field if the schema allows.
_tier_map.5: 200lb/peak -- Act 4b (wall chart + peak reveal) AND Act 5 (world + resolution). The owner's ladder has only ONE rung past 140lb, so these two acts collapse onto the same integer tier. Finer story-time deltas within tier 5 (e.g. 053's baked 'BICEPS 26' band vs. 062's corrected ~29in stat) are caption/label CONTENT, not a distinct muscle_size_tier value.

_location_note: qa-scaffold-PLAN.md section 6 assumed 'bedroom-a'/'bedroom-b' would cover every bedroom beat (reusing panel-transcriptions.md's donor-style A/B labels for context panels 026/028). Direct visual inspection of every touched bedroom panel did not support that: 014/015/017 (Act 3a) and 035/037/038/039 (Act 3c) and 063/064/065/068 (Act 5) each show decor that only partially or does not at all match either 026 ('Bedroom A': dark dresser, framed photos, two lamps) or 028 ('Bedroom B': pale walls, big window with night sky, white bedding) -- see references/ref-ledger.json scene_ladders notes for the room-by-room comparison. This shotlist therefore uses FOUR distinct bedroom location slugs (bedroom-gains, bedroom-a, bedroom-c, bedroom-peak), not two. Flagged in the final report as a plan deviation.
